meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'путаться'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'get confused', forming an aspectual pair with 'запутываться'. The reflexive suffix '-ся'/'-сь' makes the action intransitive, reciprocal, or directed at the subject.

examples.trans: I got completely confused by these rules.
